Package com.example.ecolums

Class User

java.lang.Object
com.example.ecolums.User
public class User extends Object
Represents an application user — either a Student, Club Leader, or Admin.

Responsibilities (from CRC card):

  • Maintain personal profile, role, and club membership.
  • Submit, edit, and delete personal sustainability activity logs.
  • View personal sustainability progress and dashboard metrics.
  • Participate in challenges and track badges or leaderboard ranking.
  • Manage participation in clubs, team challenges, and invitation-based membership.

Collaborators: ProgressTracker, AdminDashboard, Leaderboard, ActivityLog.

Stored in the Firestore collection users.

Outstanding issues: Firebase Authentication UID must always equal userId — this invariant is enforced at sign-up but should be validated on load.

  • Method Details

    • updateProfile

      public void updateProfile(User.OnCompleteCallback callback)
      Persists this user's profile fields (name, email, avatarUrl) to Firestore.

      Only the mutable profile fields are written; role and userId are immutable after account creation.

      Parameters:
      callback - Invoked with true on success, false on failure.

    • loadProfile

      public void loadProfile(String targetUserId, User.OnCompleteCallback callback)

      Parameters:
      targetUserId - The UID of the user to load.
      callback - Invoked with true on success, false on failure.

    • joinClubWithCode

      public void joinClubWithCode(String joinCode, User.OnCompleteCallback callback)
      Enrolls this user in a club using a valid join code or invite link.

      Looks up the club with the provided code in Firestore, validates that the code is active and not expired, then updates both the user document (setting clubId) and the club document (adding this userId to memberIds).

      Parameters:
      joinCode - The alphanumeric code entered by the user.
      callback - Invoked with true if enrollment succeeded.

    • leaveClub

      public void leaveClub(User.OnCompleteCallback callback)
      Removes this user from their current club.

      Clears clubId on the user document and removes this userId from the club's memberIds array.

      Parameters:
      callback - Invoked with true on success.

    • addPoints

      public void addPoints(double pointsToAdd, User.OnCompleteCallback callback)
      Adds the specified number of green points to this user's total and persists the updated total to Firestore.

      After updating points, calls ProgressTracker.checkMilestonesForUser(com.example.ecolums.User, com.example.ecolums.ProgressTracker.OnMilestonesCheckedCallback) to determine whether any badges should be awarded.

      Parameters:
      pointsToAdd - Number of points earned from a new activity log.
      callback - Invoked with true on success.

    • awardBadge

      public void awardBadge(Badge badge, User.OnCompleteCallback callback)
      Marks a badge as earned for this user, storing it in the users/{userId}/badges sub-collection and updating earnedBadgeIds.
      Parameters:
      badge - The badge to award.
      callback - Invoked with true on success.

    • joinChallenge

      public void joinChallenge(String challengeId, User.OnCompleteCallback callback)
      Enrolls this user in a specific green challenge.

      Adds userId to the challenge's participantIds array in Firestore and initialises their score entry in participantScores to 0.

      Parameters:
      challengeId - The Firestore document ID of the challenge to join.
      callback - Invoked with true on success.
